author: cinquinandy
name: animated-hero-with-web-gl-glitter
description:
A sophisticated full-screen hero component featuring smooth Framer
  Motion entrance animations and a WebGL shader-based glitter overlay. Built with React
  Three Fiber and custom GLSL shaders for realistic sparkle effects. Includes responsive
  typography with Google Fonts integration, two-column layout with
  gradient transitions, and GPU-accelerated rendering for optimal performance.
